name: TJ's Grill (Montpelier, ID) Golden Fried Pacific Cod & French Fries Basket
whyItWorks: Flaky Pacific cod fillets in a light golden batter. Flaky white fish is very gentle on digestion. Served with fries and tartar sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Fish & Chips with tartar sauce on the side; discard outer fried batter if feeling sensitive.
watchOuts: Peel off outer batter during active flares
